name: Vol-curve-confirmed funding squeeze — negative-funding long gated on a non-panic VIX regime
rationale: A positioning+sentiment composite that demands BOTH a crypto-native short-crowding extreme AND a TradFi macro all-clear before buying spot majors. THESIS: the funding-crowding reversal (deeply negative perpetual funding -> crowded shorts -> short squeeze higher) is a documented mean-reversion, but it FAILS during genuine macro liquidations, where crowded shorts keep winning as everything sells. So we ARM the negative-funding long ONLY when the broad risk regime is NOT melting down: the equity vol curve is NOT in deep backwardation (vix_term_slope above a fitted floor — backwardation = acute systemic panic that keeps shorts paid) AND VIX level is below a fitted ceiling (~28 — not a vol spike). A local price turn (rsi cross_up through a fitted oversold floor) confirms the squeeze is starting rather than catching a falling knife. The edge hedge funds miss spans two desks that never talk — crypto perp microstructure (funding) and TradFi vol structure (VIX term + level) — on spot majors too small to bother. DISCONFIRMERS (both must be beaten after FDR + purged holdout): Control 1 is the bare negative-funding+rsi long with NO vix gates (does the macro gate add net deflated-Sharpe, or just shrink the sample?); Control 2 INVERTS the vix condition (take the funding long ONLY during VIX-spike / backwardation) — if the inverted gate does equally well, the regime thesis is wrong and we are just trading funding. The composite must beat the un-gated funding version AND the inverted-gate version. No magic numbers — every threshold is fit by the grid.
catalyst: Deeply negative perp funding (crowded shorts) sets up a squeeze; we only take the long when the equity vol curve and VIX level confirm the macro regime is not in acute systemic panic, so the squeeze can actually fire.
